The baby was naked in the bath.

items.exampleZh: 他的鬍子讓他看起來比較老。

items.audioEn: The cotton shirt is cheaper, but the silk one is softer.

items.sentenceEn: He shaved off his beard before the interview.
items.sentenceZh: 面試前他把鬍子刮掉了。

items.sentenceEn: The dog has a red collar with its name on it.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻狗戴著一個寫有牠名字的紅色項圈。

items.stemEn: She went ____ when she heard the bad news.
items.stemZh: 聽到壞消息時，她臉色變得蒼白。

items.stemEn: In winter, I wear warm ____ to keep my feet dry.
items.stemZh: 冬天我穿保暖的靴子，讓腳保持乾爽。

items.passageEn: My grandfather has a small clothes shop in the old market. He sells shirts made of cotton and silk, and he can fix any collar or sleeve. When a customer tries on a shirt, he pins it to show where to change it. In winter, he also sells leather boots. He prefers pale colors because he says they never go out of fashion. He rarely raises his prices, so his shop is always busy. Many customers know him by his long white beard.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺在老市場開了一家小服飾店。他賣棉和絲做的襯衫，任何衣領或袖子他都會修。客人試穿襯衫時，他會用別針別出要修改的地方。冬天時，他也賣皮靴。他偏好淡淡的顏色，因為他說這些顏色永遠不會退流行。他很少漲價，所以店裡總是很忙。很多客人都是靠他那把白色長鬍子認得他。

questions.questionZh: 爺爺為什麼偏好淡淡的顏色？

items.promptZh: 她用別針把一朵花別在襯衫上。
referenceEn: She pinned a flower to her shirt.
She often pins a flower onto her shirt.
rubricZh: pin 當動詞「用別針別住」，例如 pin A to／on B 等說法
